designed.shape_derivative_boundary_rationale: No separate boundary term was extracted; the problem is formulated on the fixed design domain D with topology described by chi(x), so the volume expression contains all domain contributions.

optimization_config.rationale: defaults for level-set topology optimization on a unit square; hmin/hmax scale with the domain, diffusion and v0 are standard stabilization values, 40 iterations is a balanced default, the initial level set is a centred circle of radius 0.25, and boundary label 3 is fixed because it is the Dirichlet boundary
